headline: The memory-boundary and trusted-seam repairs are real, demonstrated and regression-locked. This lane does NOT self-certify, does NOT adopt, and does NOT close F7-RR-04G. Cutover still holds shut.

self_certification.relationship_to_that_review: this lane REPAIRS the concrete defects it identified and independently reproduced them first-hand (D1 out-of-bounds read and silent truncation on BOTH A and B; D2 leak measured at +19,999 lists per 20,000 calls). Repairing a finding is not the same as accepting the reviewer's conclusion, and the independent reviewer has NOT re-run against this branch.

what_a_reviewer_must_still_do: independently re-run the evil-list/tuple __len__ reproducers against both rebuilt modules and confirm refusal with no out-of-bounds access

independently re-run the leak bounds and, critically, independently isolate the residual ~15 blocks/call Stage B decide() leak that this lane could not localise further than the source-ref ordering block
review the transactional fail_init paths for completeness across every fallible step
review the tp_traverse/tp_clear pairs for completeness, since a missed strong reference would re-introduce an uncollectable cycle
review the trusted-seam TCB argument and decide whether ASSUMED TRUSTED callables are acceptable for any future authority path
attempt reliable OOM injection for the module-init paths, which this lane justified by source inspection rather than by test
confirm that Stage A's newly load-bearing trusted_semantic_hash seam does not widen any future authority path

cutover_holds.next_stage_dispatch: NOT auto-dispatched. Stage C must be separately commissioned, and only after the residual leak is closed and an independent review has re-run against this branch.

four_attacks_and_five_positives.detail: the four HQ234-HQ236 hostile variants and the five HQD216 lawful positives remain Stage D gates against the actual native P07->F7 interface. No production cutover exists, so no real native F7 call path exists to attack. This repair neither satisfies nor weakens them.
